command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/numba
cd /tmp
: > pipeline-r1.log; : > pipeline-r2.log; : > compare.log; : > steps.csv
echo "== the staged dataset and scripts must match their pins =="
printf 'c55594bd58d86624f9d55626f841cb97aabf401e2ffed918933df214c693aa29  ed5d841d-6346-47d4-ab2f-7119ad7e3a35.h5ad\n722c62270388f6783e0ac3affdf5da38d71ba3ddcb4d3323cf63fe0fad75e17c  pipeline.py\n1c1ea5b926541500bba9a2aa7ddc9d65a1cb7dfc41343fbba060be55c28ebfc2  compare.py\n41c3904629b6cd74db955713c0cac4c3196ee803c6fe805917cf7344c347c5f7  run.sh\n' > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
. ./run.sh
